# Changes in version `r RLumBuild::.get_pkg_version()` (`r Sys.Date()`)

## `as.list.xlum_list()`

* The function no longer crashes when it encounters a curve with no value
attributes set (#9).

## `convert_rlum2xlum()`

* The `file` argument was renamed to `out_file` for consistency with the other
`convert_*2xlum()` functions (#1).

* Improved input object validation (#3).

* Objects with `.uid` slot set to `NA` and no `parentID` specified in the
`info` slot field can now be converted correctly (#5).

* The attributes from the `xlum_prototype` file are read only once and then
cached, rather than at each function call (#7).

* The objects generated by the function no longer produce validation errors
when checked with `validate_xlum()` (#11).

* The generation of the `startDate` field for Daybreak files has been made
more robust to accommodate the various date formats used by this file type
(#15).

* The conversion of `RLum.Data.Spectrum` objects has been fixed to set
the `tValues`, `xValues`, `xLabel`, `xUnit`, `vLabel` and `vUnit` attributes
correctly (#17).

## Other changes

* The documentation was revamped.

# Changes in version 0.1.0 (2022-11-25)

* Initial version
